# Real estate paraphrases

445 real estate queries. The founder demo is first.

## 1. pull house comparisons for me to make a CMA"

- Header: For pulling comps for a CMA, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can gather comparable sales and draft a CMA, and you still pick the final comps and set the price. MLS access depends on the tool and your board.
- Domain: cma-comps
- Cards:
  - Cloud CMA — Specialist · Docs checked — Cloud CMA builds a CMA report from MLS comps and leaves the list price with the agent.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to gather comparable sales and draft a CMA you still edit before setting a price.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of comps, adjustments, and the price you still choose.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of sold homes, prices, and which ones you might drop.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced notes on how a CMA is built, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to list which sold homes are weak comps before you set a list price.

## 2. can you instagram for realtors?

- Header: For posting social media for an agent, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can draft listing posts and a weekly social calendar for an agent, and you still approve what gets published.
- Domain: agent-social
- Cards:
  - Buffer — Specialist · Docs checked — Buffer schedules listing posts and drafts captions for an agent's social channels.
  - Hootsuite — Specialist · Docs checked — Hootsuite publishes an agent's social posts from one suite.
  - Ocoya — Specialist · Docs checked — Ocoya creates listing posts and puts them on a social schedule.
  - Predis.ai — Specialist · Docs checked — Predis.ai generates social posts and ad creatives for a listing.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to draft a listing post and a weekly social calendar an agent still approves.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of listing posts, the channel, and the day they go out.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of an agent's posts, the listing, and the publish date.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced notes on real estate social posts, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to rewrite a listing caption so it states one fact and does not invent a price.

## 30. can you pull house comparisons for me to make a CMA"?

- Header: For pulling comps for a CMA, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can gather comparable sales and draft a CMA, and you still pick the final comps and set the price. MLS access depends on the tool and your board.
- Domain: cma-comps
- Cards:
  - Cloud CMA — Specialist · Docs checked — Cloud CMA builds a CMA report from MLS comps and leaves the list price with the agent.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to gather comparable sales and draft a CMA you still edit before setting a price.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of comps, adjustments, and the price you still choose.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of sold homes, prices, and which ones you might drop.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced notes on how a CMA is built, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to list which sold homes are weak comps before you set a list price.

# Other paraphrases

## 1. investment portfolio

- Header: For managing an investment portfolio, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can help you manage an investment portfolio by lining up accounts, comparing fees, and drafting questions about risk.
- Domain: manage-portfolio
- Cards:
  - PortfolioPilot — Specialist · Docs checked — PortfolioPilot tracks your accounts and assesses the portfolio.
  - Magnifi — Specialist · Docs checked — Magnifi links brokerage accounts and shows a portfolio summary.
  - Composer — Specialist · Docs checked — Composer automates a trading strategy on an investment account.
  - Kubera — Specialist · Docs checked — Kubera tracks a household balance sheet next to the rest of an investment portfolio.
  - Range — Specialist · Docs checked — Range tracks portfolio, tax, and equity details with Rai, the assistant inside its advisory membership.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to separate the accounts in an investment portfolio and list fee questions worth asking.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a holdings checklist you can fill in before comparing allocation.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet with one row per account and a column for annual cost.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for linked explanations of index funds versus active funds you can read yourself.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to spell out risk questions to ask before moving money between accounts.

## 29. file my 1040

- Header: For filing your 1040, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can sort tax records, list deductions, and draft questions for a tax pro so you still decide what to file.
- Domain: do-taxes
- Cards:
  - TurboTax — Specialist · Docs checked — TurboTax guides a personal tax return from the first question to the filed form.
  - TaxAct — Specialist · Docs checked — TaxAct walks a personal return through guided questions so the taxes get filed online.
  - FlyFin — Specialist · Docs checked — FlyFin finds deductions and has a CPA file self-employed taxes.
  - Keeper — Specialist · Docs checked — Keeper tracks expenses and files federal and state taxes, including quarterly payments.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to sort income and possible deductions into questions for a tax pro.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of forms and receipts to gather before you file.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet that tracks documents you still need for a tax return.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced pages about common deductions, with links you can check before you file.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to draft questions about credits and deductions for a tax pro to answer.

## 57. customer support

- Header: For handling customer support tickets, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can read a support ticket, draft a reply about refunds or order status, and mark what a person should still handle.
- Domain: customer-support
- Cards:
  - Intercom Fin — Specialist · Docs checked — Intercom Fin answers customer conversations inside a support inbox.
  - Decagon — Specialist · Docs checked — Decagon handles customer chat, email, and voice in one support conversation.
  - Zendesk — Specialist · Docs checked — Zendesk runs a support suite and applies its AI to service tickets.
  - Sierra — Specialist · Docs checked — Sierra builds customer-service agents for a brand's support conversations.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to turn a support ticket about a refund or an order into a reply a person still approves.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of order facts to confirm before answering a customer.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet that tracks ticket status, the order, and who replies next.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced help-center pages about refunds and shipping, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to draft a calm reply that states what is known and what a person must still decide.

## 85. sales outreach

- Header: For help with sales outreach, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can research a sales lead, draft the outreach, and leave the final send for you to approve.
- Domain: sales-outreach
- Cards:
  - Instantly — Specialist · Docs checked — Instantly sends sales email sequences from more than one inbox.
  - Apollo — Specialist · Docs checked — Apollo looks up contacts and companies before anyone writes sales outreach.
  - Smartlead — Specialist · Docs checked — Smartlead sets up cold-email outreach and fixes the sequence when it breaks.
  - Clay — Specialist · Docs checked — Clay pulls lead data from many providers into one table for outreach.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to outline how to research a lead and which outreach sentence you would actually send.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a qualification checklist before you add a prospect to a pipeline.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of leads, last contact, and the next outreach step.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced background on a company you might email, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to rewrite a cold email so the ask is specific and you still choose what gets sent.

## 141. email inbox

- Header: For managing an email inbox, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can triage an email inbox, summarize a thread, and draft a reply you can edit before it sends.
- Domain: manage-inbox
- Cards:
  - Fyxer — Specialist · Docs checked — Fyxer organizes an email inbox and drafts the replies.
  - Spark — Specialist · Docs checked — Spark drafts email replies and sorts the inbox.
  - Shortwave — Specialist · Docs checked — Shortwave searches an email inbox and drafts from that client.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to group an email inbox into threads that need a reply and threads to archive.

  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of senders, subjects, and whether a reply is still owed.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced tips on inbox triage habits, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to draft a short reply to one thread and list what you should not promise.

  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to revise a paragraph so the claim is narrower and easier to check.

## 253. analyze data

- Header: For analyzing data, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can read a spreadsheet, summarize what the columns show, and draft a report you can check against the source table.
- Domain: analyze-data
- Cards:
  - Julius — Specialist · Docs checked — Julius answers questions about data in a spreadsheet chat.
  - Hex — Specialist · Docs checked — Hex keeps a shared notebook where a team analyzes data with its agent.
  - Rows — Specialist · Docs checked — Rows analyzes spreadsheet data with an assistant sitting in the grid.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to explain what spreadsheet columns show and which total you should recompute.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of filters, totals, and charts to build from a table.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet layout for a report, with one tab for the source numbers.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced definitions of the metrics in a report, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to list which figures in a table do not support the conclusion someone wrote.

  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to draft candidate outreach that a recruiter can edit before it is sent.

## 309. book travel

- Header: For booking travel, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can plan travel by comparing flights, hotels, and vacation deals and drafting an itinerary you can book yourself.
- Domain: plan-travel
- Cards:
  - Wonderplan — Specialist · Docs checked — Wonderplan plans a hotel stay inside a trip itinerary.
  - GuideGeek — Specialist · Docs checked — GuideGeek plans travel across flights, stays, restaurants, and experiences.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to draft an itinerary with flights, hotels, and the decisions you still book yourself.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a packing and booking checklist for a trip.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of flight options, hotels, and dates in separate columns.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced pages on neighborhoods and transit, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to compare two hotel descriptions and say what is still unconfirmed.

## 365. accounts payable invoices

- Header: For help with accounts payable invoices, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can read an invoice, pull out the fields, and flag expenses that do not match a purchase order so a person can approve the exception.
- Domain: finance-ops
- Cards:
  - Vic.ai — Specialist · Docs checked — Vic.ai reads invoices for an accounts-payable team.
  - Dext — Specialist · Docs checked — Dext captures receipts and invoices so bookkeeping can process them.
  - BILL — Specialist · Docs checked — BILL sends invoices and pays bills inside one finance product.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to pull invoice fields into a list and flag lines that do not match a purchase order.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for an accounts-payable checklist before someone approves a payment.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of invoice number, amount, and exception status.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced explainers of purchase-order matching, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to state which invoice lines a person should reject or question.

## 421. profit and loss

- Header: For reading your profit and loss, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can read a spreadsheet of income and expenses and draft a cash-flow or profit-and-loss summary. You recompute the totals before you trust them.
- Domain: analyze-data
- Cards:
  - Julius — Specialist · Docs checked — Julius answers questions about the data in a cash-flow or profit-and-loss spreadsheet.
  - Rows — Specialist · Docs checked — Rows totals a spreadsheet of income and expenses into a report you can check.
  - Hex — Specialist · Docs checked — Hex charts financial data in a shared notebook so the report starts from the sheet.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to explain a cash-flow spreadsheet and name the total you should recompute.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of income, expenses, and the months a cash-flow sheet should show.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet layout for profit and loss, with one tab for the source numbers.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced definitions of cash-flow terms, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to list which figures in a profit-and-loss table do not support the conclusion.

## 477. shopify

- Header: For automating repeated tasks, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can connect the store, order, and shipping apps you already use and pass a step from one app to the next. You still confirm the count and the label.
- Domain: workflow-automation
- Cards:
  - n8n — Specialist · Docs checked — n8n runs multi-step workflows you can host yourself for a repeated task.
  - Make — Specialist · Docs checked — Make builds visual automations across the apps a repeated task touches.
  - Zapier — Specialist · Docs checked — Zapier connects the apps you already use so a step in one triggers a step in another.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to map a repeated task into steps you approve before any app runs them.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of triggers, apps, and the step that must stay manual.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of workflow steps, the app each one touches, and who approves it.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced docs on the apps a workflow would connect, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to point out which step in an automation description is still vague.

## 757. help desk

- Header: For handling IT help desk requests, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can triage an IT help desk ticket, draft a password-reset step, and route what a person still has to do.
- Domain: it-helpdesk
- Cards:
  - Freshservice — Specialist · Docs checked — Freshservice runs an IT service desk that takes incoming requests.
  - Moveworks — Specialist · Docs checked — Moveworks routes employee IT requests and answers common ones itself.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to triage an IT help desk ticket and write the password-reset steps a person still runs.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist that separates a password reset from a ticket that needs an admin.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of tickets, the owner, and the next handoff.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced vendor docs about a common IT error, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to draft a help desk reply that says what was tried and what is still blocked.

## 841. personalized learning

- Header: For getting tutoring help, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can tutor by explaining a concept, drafting practice problems, and tracking which ones you still miss.
- Domain: tutoring
- Cards:
  - Khanmigo — Specialist · Docs checked — Khanmigo tutors a student through a problem step by step.
  - Quizlet — Specialist · Docs checked — Quizlet turns notes into a practice test and explains a homework step with more practice.
  - StudyFetch — Specialist · Docs checked — StudyFetch explains a subject from your materials and builds practice from them.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to explain one concept and then write practice problems that test only that idea.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a study checklist with what to review and which problems to retry.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet that tracks which practice problems you still miss.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced lessons on the topic, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to show a worked example and then a similar problem with the answer withheld.

## 925. sizzle reel

- Header: For help with a sizzle reel, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can find moments in a long video, reframe them, and draft captions so you can publish clips without watching the whole file again.
- Domain: game-creative
- Cards:
  - Opus Clip — Specialist · Docs checked — Opus Clip cuts a long video into short clips.
  - Captions — Specialist · Docs checked — Captions trims a video and adds on-screen words for a social clip.
  - CapCut — Specialist · Docs checked — CapCut edits video for YouTube, TikTok, and Reels, including basic cuts.
  - Eklipse — Specialist · Docs checked — Eklipse finds vertical highlight clips from Twitch, YouTube, and Kick.
  - StreamLadder — Specialist · Docs checked — StreamLadder reframes a horizontal stream clip into a vertical short for Reels or TikTok.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to outline short-clip moments from a long video and draft captions you can edit.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of clip length, caption, and the shot you still need.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of timecodes, captions, and which clip is ready.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced notes on framing and captions for short video, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to pick which moments in a long video are worth cutting into a short clip.

## 1093. pull request

- Header: For pulling request, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can read a repo, suggest a code edit, and draft a review note so you can check the change before it ships.
- Domain: coding-agents
- Cards:
  - GitHub Copilot — Specialist · Docs checked — GitHub Copilot writes code and can carry a change toward a merge.
  - Cursor — Specialist · Docs checked — Cursor edits code in the repo from a desktop agent.
  - Continue — Specialist · Docs checked — Continue installs an open-source coding agent in the editor you already use.
  - Replit — Specialist · Not fully checked — Replit runs a coding agent inside a browser editor.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to read a bug report and suggest a code edit plus a review note you can reject.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a debugging checklist before you change a repo.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a doc that tracks the failing test, the hypothesis, and the diff.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced docs on the error or library, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to fill in a function from the code before and after the gap, then explain the edit.

## 1121. personal tasks

- Header: For help with personal tasks, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can connect the apps in a repeated workflow and run the steps you approve.
- Domain: workflow-automation
- Cards:
  - Zapier — Specialist · Docs checked — Zapier connects the apps you already use so a step in one triggers a step in another.
  - n8n — Specialist · Docs checked — n8n runs multi-step workflows you can host yourself for a repeated task.
  - Make — Specialist · Docs checked — Make builds visual automations across the apps a repeated task touches.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to map a repeated task into steps you approve before any app runs them.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of triggers, apps, and the step that must stay manual.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of workflow steps, the app each one touches, and who approves it.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced docs on the apps a workflow would connect, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to point out which step in an automation description is still vague.

## 1149. multi-agent

- Header: For splitting one job across several agents, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can split a job into steps and hand each step to another agent, while you still approve what gets sent.
- Domain: multi-agent-workflows
- Cards:
  - CrewAI — Specialist · Smoke-tested — CrewAI splits one job across agents that each have a role.
  - AutoGen (Microsoft) — Specialist · Smoke-tested — AutoGen (Microsoft) runs conversations between several agents in Python.
  - LangChain — Specialist · Smoke-tested — LangChain composes agents that call tools in code you write.
  - Dify — Specialist · Docs checked — Dify lays out agent workflows on a visual canvas you can host.
  - Flowise — Specialist · Docs checked — Flowise assembles low-code model flows for agents on a server you run.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to split one job into steps and say which step a second agent could draft.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a handoff checklist so each agent has one output you can approve.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of steps, the agent assigned, and whether you accepted the result.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced pages on multi-agent patterns, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to rewrite a crew plan so you still approve anything that gets sent.

## 1177. vector database

- Header: For building a RAG pipeline, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can open source pages, compare what they say, and draft a short brief so you can check the links yourself.
- Domain: research-rag
- Cards:
  - Pinecone — Specialist · Docs checked — Pinecone keeps vectors a search uses to look up source pages.
  - Mem0 — Specialist · Smoke-tested — Mem0 stores memory an agent can read later when it answers from source pages.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to outline a RAG pipeline from source pages to a short answer you can trace.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of crawl, chunk, retrieve, and the citation you expect back.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of source URLs, the passage used, and the answer it supports.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced intros to vector search, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to say which part of a retrieval answer is not backed by the passages you paste in.

## 1205. meeting notes

- Header: For turning a meeting into notes and tasks, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can turn meeting notes or a transcript into decisions and action items so you can edit the list instead of replaying the call.
- Domain: meetings-knowledge
- Cards:
  - Granola — Specialist · Docs checked — Granola takes meeting notes alongside the call.
  - Obsidian — Specialist · Docs checked — Obsidian stores meeting notes in files on your computer.
  - Notion — Specialist · Docs checked — Notion keeps meeting notes and the docs around them in one workspace.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to turn meeting notes into decisions and action items you can edit.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist that separates decisions, owners, and due dates.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a doc of action items with owner and date columns.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced tips on meeting notes, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to extract tasks from a transcript and drop anything that was only an aside.

## 1233. computer use

- Header: For automating steps in a web browser, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can follow steps in a browser you direct, and stop when a login or captcha appears, so a repeated web task has a written path.
- Domain: tool-use-browser
- Cards:
  - Browser Use — Specialist · Smoke-tested — Browser Use opens pages and clicks through the steps in a browser.
  - Composio — Specialist · Docs checked — Composio connects an agent to outside apps when the job needs more than browser steps.
  - Skyvern — Specialist · Docs checked — Skyvern automates clicks and form steps inside a browser.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to write browser steps for a repeated web task and mark where a login should stop you.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of form fields and the step that needs a person.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of page, field, and the value a browser step may enter.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced docs on browser automation limits, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to review a click-path and name the step that should stop at a captcha.

## 1261. game master

- Header: For help with a game master, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can draft what an in-game character says, while the game still decides which lines are allowed.
- Domain: game-npcs
- Cards:
  - Tavernbard — Specialist · Docs checked — Tavernbard plays a game master in Discord and can speak character lines there.
  - Inworld — Specialist · Docs checked — Inworld writes dialogue for a game character on a hosted stack.
  - Convai — Specialist · Docs checked — Convai runs characters that talk with the player inside a game.
  - NVIDIA ACE for Games — Specialist · Docs checked — NVIDIA ACE for Games offers downloads and plugins for an in-game character.
  - MistScale — Specialist · Docs checked — MistScale remembers what a game character should know about the player.
  - Claude (Anthropic) — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Claude to draft dialogue for an in-game character, and you decide which lines are allowed.
  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of character voice, forbidden topics, and sample lines.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet of NPC lines, the trigger, and whether the game may say them.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced notes on dialogue design, with links you can check.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to rewrite a character line so it stays in the voice you described.

## 2. find homes for sale by owner

- Header: For finding homes for sale by owner, here's how each tool can help:

  - PropStream — Specialist · Docs checked — PropStream searches property records, including off-market listings, from one set of filters.
  - REsimpli — Specialist · Docs checked — REsimpli calls, texts, and emails owners from the same CRM.

  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to reason through which owner details are still missing before you send a note.

## 26. agent for taxes

- Header: For doing your taxes, here's how each tool can help:
- Intro: AI agents can sort tax records, list deductions, and draft questions for a tax pro so you still decide what to file.

  - TurboTax — Specialist · Docs checked — TurboTax guides a personal tax return from the first question to the filed form.

  - ChatGPT — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask ChatGPT for a checklist of forms and receipts to gather before you file.
  - Google Gemini — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask Gemini to build a sheet that tracks documents you still need for a tax return.
  - Perplexity — General-purpose AI assistant · Not fully checked — Ask Perplexity for sourced pages about common deductions, with links you can check before you file.
  - DeepSeek — General-purpose AI assistant · Docs checked — Ask DeepSeek to draft questions about credits and deductions for a tax pro to answer.
